subject: learning/shared-test-deadline
statement: Coverage measurement supplies an explicit 20-minute Go package timeout, matching the shared required gate's existing outer budget.
intent: Allow the complete real-Git integration suite to finish under concurrent race and coverage execution without an earlier implicit package alarm.
rationale: The full memory CLI race suite passed alone in 346 seconds, while the concurrent shared runs reached Go's implicit 600-second package deadline without assertion failures. Every test, uncached coverage measurement, coverage floor, race check, and outer deadline remains enforced. The 90 sibling-merge cases now use four isolated checkouts at a time.
